central_new_return.body:
## [DEVICE] DV006：亮度手势全平台无效根因与原生实现（已推送，待 review 后定归并）/ MK-ROUTING-20261011

用户报告亮度手势在多台安卓设备上均无效（数字变、亮度不变）。定位与修复：

### 根因（结构缺失）

App 只依赖 `screen_brightness_platform_interface`（2.1.2，纯 Dart 接口包），通道 `github.com/aaassseee/screen_brightness` 在 Android 原生侧**无任何 handler**（lock 无平台实现包、原生目录无处理代码）→ 全部调用抛 `MissingPluginException` → `setBrightness` 的 `catch (_) {}` 静默吞掉 → overlay 数字（本地值）变化而实际亮度永不变化。多机一致 = 结构性通道缺失。

### 修复（PiliPlusX DV003 分支 9895e7dc0）

`ScreenBrightnessHandler.kt`（原生，MainActivity attach/onDestroy stop）：
- MethodChannel 全方法：get/setSystemScreenBrightness（Settings.System 归一化 0..1；**写入时若处于自动亮度模式先切手动**——否则写值无可见效果，即用户报告的直接原因之一）、get/set/resetApplicationScreenBrightness（Activity window screenBrightness，NaN=清除）、hasApplicationScreenBrightnessChanged/isAutoReset/setAutoReset/isAnimate/setAnimate/canChangeSystemBrightness
- system_brightness_changed EventChannel：ContentObserver 监听系统亮度
- application_brightness_changed EventChannel：sink 注册/注销

### 验证状态（如实）

- 启动期无 MissingPluginException（通道注册成功）
- **手势与亮度联动待用户手动滑动复核**——合成输入（adb swipe）无法触发该 Flutter 手势，自动化验证不可用
- 屏幕已灭屏

### 边界说明

- system 写入自动切手动模式：业界常规，但属行为变更，请 review 确认
- reset 语义与退出播放还原链（controller.dart:3973）保持既有设计
- 该修复与 DV003/004/005（126 链路）独立；已 push 至 device/MK-ROUTING-20261011/DV003 分支头（9895e7dc0），**未经 review 前不请求归并**

new_findings.title: Reset stores NaN instead of Android no-override sentinel
new_findings.reason: Double.NaN passes through Double.coerceIn(0,1); both comparisons are false and Kotlin returns the receiver. It is written into window.attributes.screenBrightness. Getter tests attr<0 (false for NaN), returns NaN, and upstream interface range check rejects it. hasChanged >=0 is false despite the invalid attribute.
new_findings.actual_app_path: Pref.setSystemBrightness defaults false (storage_pref.dart:1079-1080); video view didPushNext and didPopNext invoke reset at 485-486 and 528-542. pl_player/controller.dart:3973-3974 resets when final Android player disposes; live page reset also exists. App application getter async .then has no catch at pl_player/view/view.dart:195-200.
source_derived_reproduction: invoke reset; attribute becomes NaN instead of -1f
get application brightness; returns NaN and Dart range validation throws
This is source-derived reasoning. No Kotlin/native/Dart execution or actual screen outcome claimed.
new_findings.required_fix_and_validation: Use actual BRIGHTNESS_OVERRIDE_NONE, preserve finite getter fallback, and validate set/reset/get plus leave/reenter and system following using real native contract.

new_findings.title: Content observer can emit on a notification/Binder thread
new_findings.reason: ContentObserver has null Handler, so onChange is invoked immediately on dispatching thread, with no main-thread hop before EventSink.success. Default Flutter BinaryMessenger sends are UI/platform-thread calls. Callback is outside MethodCall handler try/catch.
source_derived_reproduction: Subscribe to system brightness event in actual App system mode.
System settings provider notifies from outside UI thread.
Observer directly sends Flutter event from notification thread; contract is violated and send may fail. Actual device failure trace not captured by this review.
new_findings.required_fix_and_validation: Bind observer/event emission to appropriate platform thread and check real settings/control-center notification with thread assertion.

new_findings.title: Application EventChannel never emits any event
new_findings.reason: applicationSink is assigned or cleared but never called. set/reset do not emit, and system observer registration occurs only when systemEvents has a listener. App default application mode subscribes only application stream, so system-following changes and native set/reset cannot reach that subscription.
new_findings.actual_app_path: pl_player/view/view.dart:340-344 subscribes onApplicationScreenBrightnessChanged; 165-169 applies event to brightness state and gesture baseline when not currently dragging.
new_findings.required_fix_and_validation: Emit interface-prescribed set/reset and effective application brightness changes; cover cleared override follows system, overridden brightness policy, stream cancellation and actual view listener.

new_findings.title: Permission capability is constant true and system write results are ignored
new_findings.reason: Manifest declares WRITE_SETTINGS but API23+ requires separately granted write-settings capability. canChangeSystemBrightness returns true unconditionally. Both Settings.System.putInt Boolean results are ignored; exception turns into generic channel error, which existing App setter swallows; false result becomes success.
new_findings.actual_app_path: User optional system-brightness preference defaults false. System-mode getter/subscription and setter are pl_player/view/view.dart:333-338,411-420. Review concerns enabling this optional mode without granted permission, revocation and provider false, not default application-mode authorization.
new_findings.required_fix_and_validation: Query real canWrite on applicable APIs; handle permission state and write failures without reporting false success; verify granted/denied/revoked/provider-failure paths.
new_findings.behavior_scope_note: Automatic-to-manual changes a persistent global setting. DEVICE central 6127973022 acknowledges the behavior change and asks review. This audit does not infer product approval from the channel repair claim and does not introduce or decide a new user policy.

new_findings.title: stop does not unregister Activity-capturing channel handlers
new_findings.reason: stop only unregisters observer and clears sinks. MethodChannel and EventChannel handlers remain registered and capture this handler and strong Activity. Pinned AudioServiceActivity returns AudioServicePlugin.getFlutterEngine; pinned plugin caches the engine and its dispose method may retain it if an activity is attached. In a retained-engine detach/recreation scenario, stale handlers can access old Activity or re-register observer on later listen.
new_findings.scope_qualification: Not a claim that every Activity destruction retains engine or necessarily leaks permanently. This is a retained/reused-engine correctness path exposed by current dependency and incomplete detach.
new_findings.required_fix_and_validation: Implement matching attach/detach ownership and cleanup for handlers/observer/activity references. Test same engine with Activity detach/recreate, including old detach after new attach not removing new owner bindings.

non_findings_and_limits: MethodChannel and EventChannel names match upstream interface; events are raw doubles, not map payloads. No protocol payload type mismatch alleged.
isAutoReset/setAutoReset and isAnimate/setAnimate are documented iOS-only in upstream interface. Their Android no-op/false replies are not listed as blockers.
Unused imports and unused duplicate applicationEventsHandler are nonblocking cleanup and not used to inflate findings.
Default application brightness path does not require system WRITE_SETTINGS permission. Permission finding applies to optional system mode and truthful capability/write results.
No local compile, Kotlin/Dart test, APK inspection or device screen brightness run was performed. Source-derived reproduction is distinguished from executed reproduction.
